content: For a >1k upgrade, it would be nice if another 'universal' wrench were included, it's a pretty small easy to use tool that I've never had to use between when I purchased the printer and now and I honestly have no idea where it is. :/

Hopefully when you replace the spark plugs on your car you do one at a time, don't remove all cables first :) and yes, this upgrade is damn expensive.
I just got an 8mm 🔧 from the toolbox.  I recycled the stamped thing they sent long ago.  I am glad I did not need to pay for another tool to toss
